gbm_population_evidence.quote: Phase 2 Subprotocol of AG-120 (Ivosidenib) in Patients With Tumors Harboring IDH1 Mutations
Patient must have enrolled onto APEC1621SC (NCT03155620) and must have been given a treatment assignment to MATCH to APEC1621K based on the presence of an actionable mutation as defined in APEC1621SC

candidate_evidence.quote: Patients receive ivosidenib PO QD. Cycles repeat every 28 days for up to 2 years in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: that have not responded to (refractory) or have come back after (recurrent) prior treatment that have IDH (isocitrate dehydrogenase) 1 genetic alterations (mutations)

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: A descriptive analysis of PK parameters will be performed to define systemic exposure, drug clearance, and other pharmacokinetic parameters.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To provide preliminary estimates of the pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics of AG-120 (ivosidenib) in children and adolescents with relapsed or refractory cancer.

role_evidence.quote: Patients receive ivosidenib PO QD. Cycles repeat every 28 days for up to 2 years in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: may block the growth of cancer cells that have specific genetic changes in the IDH pathway

source_quote.quote: Phase 2 Subprotocol of AG-120 (Ivosidenib) in Patients With Tumors Harboring IDH1 Mutations
Will explore approaches to the profiling changes in tumor genomics over time through evaluation of circulating tumor deoxyribonucleic acid.

coder_notes: Paediatric MATCH basket (ages 12 months to 21 years; stdAges CHILD, ADULT). Glioblastoma is never named in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels; only 'Recurrent/Refractory Malignant Glioma' and 'WHO Grade 2 Glioma' appear, and entry requires an IDH1 mutation, so any glioma enrolled would be IDH-mutant (not glioblastoma under CNS5). Coded not_glioblastoma; high_grade_glioma_unspecified would be the alternative value, with the same exclusion. Pharmacodynamics of ivosidenib are a stated secondary objective but sample type and markers are not specified.
